title: Could you advise on the expected dress code for daily activities?

segments.text: Since Ashaeiynn is a sacred space and active spiritual home, we ask all guests to dress in simple, modest, and comfortable clothing that respects the sacred environment. Loose-fitting attire like traditional Indian wear (such as kurta-pyjamas or salwar-kameez) or loose pants and tops are ideal, especially for sitting comfortably during long chanting sessions and havan. ​Please ensure shoulders and knees are covered at all times. Women are also requested to bring a scarf (dupatta) to cover their heads during the havan. You are welcome to change into comfortable nightsuit when retiring for the evening. Overall, dressing simply helps keep our collective focus where it belongs: on our sadhana and spiritual growth.
